Since 96 is merged, let’s make use of it:
- use ACTS for the current Tracker (via DD4Hep -> Acts::TrackingGeometry)
- run the propagation example for the 3 T field map (1, 10, 100 GeV pT)
- make nSensitives vs eta (split in sub detector and full) as profile plots
- use unrooted to make some pretty plots
- make the process repeatable - we will use it later
I’ll check the current tracker conversion and 3 T field-map setup, then build a repeatable propagation workflow and use unrooted to plot the sensitive crossings versus η.

I’m using the `acts-spack` skill to verify the local runtime and the repository’s coordination workflow for this study. I’ll keep the propagation implementation and the independent review of the crossing-count definition separate.

The Spack preflight found changed setup-script and lockfile fingerprints, so its recorded verification is stale. I’ll recheck the installed imports and libraries before using them. The ACTS sister checkout also has existing local changes; I’ll preserve those and distinguish its source revision from the installed runtime.

I found the current 3 T DES-026 solenoid model, but no saved field-map artifact on main. Should I generate the ACTS field map from that model, or use a specific existing map?
- Generate from the current 3 T solenoid model (recommended)
- Use an existing map — I’ll provide its path

I’ll generate the map from DES-026’s 3 T finite-winding model and record its inputs, grid and interpolation checks. The run will use native DD4hep sensitive surfaces converted to ACTS, with material effects disabled. The profiles will therefore measure sensitive-plane crossings.

The generated map passed its axis and refinement checks. Its maximum sampled interpolation error is about **0.31 mT** over the tracker region. The current tracker factories also built successfully; I’m now checking the native propagation output and event accounting before choosing the full run size.

I’m retaining the per-track counts as well as the profiles, so later plots can be regenerated without rerunning propagation. The analysis also checks unrooted’s profile values against ROOT TProfiles and independent bin sums, with zero-crossing probes kept in the averages.

The first curved-propagation smoke test succeeded. The conversion contains **45,646 source-matched sensitive surfaces in 117 ACTS volumes**, and the saved summaries show the requested 1 GeV pT. I also found that the older example leaves η sampling at a default; the new workflow sets uniform η sampling explicitly.

I’ll generate the map from the current 3 T solenoid model, as requested. I’m now checking that every generated probe appears in the propagation output and that its sensitive crossings match the DD4hep source identifiers before making the profiles.

The 128-probe test accounts for every generated muon. All seven subdetector counts sum exactly to ACTS’ `nSensitives`, with no missing probes or repeated sensitive crossings. The recorded trajectories also stay inside the field map with a full integration-step margin. I’m starting the three full samples now.

The first full 8,192-probe propagation completed. The analysis stage then exposed a launcher bug: resolving the Python executable’s symlink bypassed the plotting environment and its packages. I’ve corrected the launcher and kept the native output for accounting. I’m also adding step-size and field-grid comparisons to check numerical stability.

The checks now also verify that each probe reaches the outer tracking-world boundary, so a complete summary cannot hide a step-limit or path-limit stop. The main plots will show the full tracker and the pixel, short-strip and long-strip groups; a second figure will resolve all seven DD4hep systems.

All three full samples passed: 24,576 probes, no missing or duplicated IDs, and exact agreement between source-matched crossings and ACTS summaries. The profiles include zero crossings, and the ROOT TProfiles agree with unrooted’s profiles and independent bin sums. I’m checking the figure layout and the numerical controls next.

Halving the maximum propagation step from 50 mm to 25 mm changed no per-system crossing counts in 512 paired probes at each momentum. The figures also regenerated successfully from the compressed counts saved in Git, without loading ACTS. The finer-map and independent-seed runs are still underway.

The finer field map changed one crossing for seven of the 512 paired 1 GeV probes; the 10 and 100 GeV counts were unchanged. The affected probes are all forward-going. I’m checking the individual surfaces and their edges, and will retain the differences in the report rather than call the coarse map converged.

The separate scientific review reproduced all 24,576 native counts and all 33 profiles. It found no remaining blocker for this prototype overview and confirmed that the seven map-sensitive cases lie near sensor edges. I’ll state the 1.37% changed-probe fraction in the report alongside the small net mean change, and retain the qualification that per-track map convergence is not established.

The documented Make command passed end to end in a fresh output directory. All 6,144 replay rows exactly match the corresponding nominal rows, including path lengths, and the regenerated field map is byte-identical. I’m preparing the PR with the plots, retained data, review findings and reuse instructions.

[PR #97](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/97) is open with the plots and workflow. Local validation and the token-dashboard preview passed; the final hosted checks are running. The closed issue95/PR96 accounting is also reconciled at 14,443,192 observed tokens, with this tracker work tracked separately.

Implemented in [PR #97](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/97). All hosted checks passed.

- Current DD4hep → ACTS Tracker, generated 3 T map.
- 8,192 muons each at pT **1, 10, 100 GeV**.
- Full-tracker and subdetector unrooted profiles: [plots and report]([redacted]
- Exact replay verified.

```sh
make tracker-propagation
make tracker-propagation-controls
make tracker-propagation-plot
```

Finer-map checks changed 7/512 sensitive-edge crossings at 1 GeV; that limitation is documented.

Issue95/PR96 accounting is now **14,443,192 observed tokens**. Tracker work is separate; its active parent-turn total remains unfinalized.
